methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Octavia operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at an undisclosed stage. The valuation universe consists of 11 peers in the sector: one publicly traded company (277810.KQ) and eight private firms, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the comparable set is materially constrained by stage and valuation clustering.

The peer-median approach is not applicable. Of the 11 same-sector peers identified, none satisfy narrow stage-matching or adjacent-stage filters simultaneously with comparable valuation-tier criteria. A minimum of three datapoints is required for statistical credibility; the filtered set yielded zero. Applying an all-sector median would introduce substantial bias given the heterogeneity of robotics subsectors, manufacturing applications, and company maturity levels. No alternative triangulation methods—revenue multiple, DCF, or transaction-based—could be applied given the absence of disclosed financial metrics in the data provided.

The analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without either disclosure of Octavia's stage, recent funding round terms, or financial performance data. Key uncertainties include Octavia's precise development maturity, revenue or ARR, and capital structure relative to the identified peer set. A credible valuation would require narrowing the peer universe to companies at matching stage and scale, or obtaining primary financial or market traction data from management.
